title: Return before reopening every question
summary: Clarity returns when the mind stays with one clear line. Let trust return before inquiry multiplies again.
takeaway: Let trust return before inquiry multiplies again.
lifeApplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until the breathing slows.
